notes.title: Small Patch - April 27, 2025
notes.notes:
-Bunny Fish Day has ended
-Fixed Casino bug causing slots to have lower payouts
-Removed bundle turn in bars from Cove
-Added settings option to skip fight gear confirmation
-Added more eat point allocation amounts

notes.title: Small Patch - March 2, 2025
notes.notes:
-Fixed incorrect gear cost scaling
-Fixed sometimes not being able to select Pavilion boosts
-Hatchery upgrade max temporarily disabled due to various issues
-Various UI fixes

notes.title: Balance Patch - March 1, 2025
notes.notes:
-Collection currency tooltip now shows total earned
-Decreased exp gain from crate

-Rebalanced late game scaling, the following have been increased:
Moon piece bundle scaling
Fight gear pixel cost
Fight gear cost
Gear crate cost
Sky rod upgrade costs
Vectors needed for Heart Scale

These adjustments were made due to currency gains drastically outpacing upgrade costs.
A new mechanic for online/offline gains will be added soon to compensate for increased costs.
